header_meaning.anthropic-ratelimit-input-tokens-*: uncached input + cache-write tokens per minute

local_estimate.source: this machine's own request log, rolling windows; a conservative fallback, NOT Groq's reset rule (Groq does not document how daily limits reset, and its limits are per organization)
local_estimate.used_for: RPD only when Groq reported nothing; TPD always (no provider TPD header); RPM/TPM together with the provider TPM header

provider_reported.source: Groq x-ratelimit-* response headers (requests = per day, tokens = per minute)
provider_reported.tokens_per_day: not reported in headers by Groq

quota_sources.local_estimate: this machine's own request log, rolling windows; a conservative fallback, NOT Groq's reset rule (Groq does not document how daily limits reset, and its limits are per organization)
quota_sources.provider_429_message: parsed from a Groq 429 error message (message format is not documented by Groq; best effort)
quota_sources.provider_headers: Groq x-ratelimit-* response headers (requests = per day, tokens = per minute)

resume.note: a provider-reported time is the provider's; a local estimate is conservative; unknown = try later
